Frequently asked questions.

What happens if I move away before I’m able to see the value in the service?

No problem. Either party can terminate this agreement at any time. We’ll apply the service we’ve done at retail pricing towards the total you paid for the program and refund the difference.

What about other cars in your family?

If you have multiple vehicles in your household, we will give you 20% off the price of every Lifetime Oil Change Package you purchase after your first.

What if I sell my car?

Add value to the sale price and transfer the plan! When transferred to a new vehicle owner, the first oil change is billed at full price, we’ll take care of the rest.

What if I get a new car?

If you get rid of a vehicle that you purchased a Lifetime Oil Change Package for, we will give you 20% off the price of a package for your next vehicle.
